portraits.label: Мшистый
portraits.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Generate ONE NEW original portrait for Duelyant.
Reference roles: Image 1 establishes only painting technique, crop, background and lighting, NOT facial identity or face proportions. Images 2–4 establish supporting gothic fantasy textures only; do not copy their characters, costume, anatomy or frames.
MOST IMPORTANT NEW REQUIREMENT: the fictional adult human must be genuinely visually androgynous: a viewer should find it difficult to decide whether the face is male or female. This is a sexless human game character. Do not default to a rugged masculine warrior with facial hair merely removed, and do not default to a feminine beauty model. Use a coherent natural face combining soft and firm forms subtly, middle-range cheek and lip fullness, a modest softly rounded jaw and chin, subtle brow ridge, unstyled brows, plain unstyled hair. No facial hair or beard shadow, no exaggerated square jaw or brow, no prominent Adam's apple, no breast contour, no makeup, eyeliner, lipstick, glamorous lashes, jewelry or gender-coded costume. Do not make the adult look like a child. The face must remain visible and readable: achieve ambiguity through facial anatomy, not masks, blur or darkness.
Keep diversity, mature everyday irregular faces and distinctive imperfections specified below. Avoid beauty retouch, model symmetry, heroic idealization and caricature; preserve skin texture, marks and asymmetry. Ethnic appearance and imperfections do not imply evil or moral character.
COMPOSITION AND STYLE: vertical 2:3 exactly 1024x1536. Close head-and-shoulders, head fully inside frame, eyes around 40% down. Three-quarter view turned toward IMAGE RIGHT, both eyes visible, calm restrained expression. Plain dark coarse cloth covers shoulders at bottom, with no body contours emphasized. One upper front-left light, deep charcoal shadows, almost black background with subtle dark teal. Muted organic skin tones, ochre and ivory highlights, aged gothic fantasy illustration, hand-painted etched fine texture, sculptural volume. The sculptural treatment must not turn every face into angular masculine planes. No photo, glossy CGI, anime, text, frame, collage, armor, weapons, bright magic or accessories. Old scars fully healed, no fresh injuries or blood.
NEW CHARACTER: East Asian appearance, age 28, warm beige skin. Broad soft oval face, gentle cheek volume, low nasal bridge, dark monolid eyes, moderate plain lips, gently rounded small chin. Straight black hair at ear length with a casually uneven fringe, not a fashionable haircut. Unequal eyebrows and subtle acne pitting on cheeks; one small brown mole near the mouth. Androgyny must be stronger than Image 1: less heavy brow and jaw, neither rugged nor pretty.
